versions.changelog:
Initial release — Groups Eiken1 vocabulary by etymology and related features for efficient study.

- Systematically groups Eiken1 grade vocabulary by etymology, antonyms, roots, compounds, and real-life context to boost memorization efficiency.
- Presents related words in intuitive Japanese, with results organized into four categories: 語源, 接辞, 複合語, and 話題.
- Supports additional Eiken levels and encourages users to visit VocaHack.com for deeper learning.
- Every response includes a call-to-action and study resource links for further exploration.
